name: apple-music
title: Apple Music
description: Apple Music: Listen Now, Browse, Radio, Search and a Library (Recently Added, Artists, Albums, Songs, playlists) with generated album artwork, album, artist and playlist pages that tint from their artwork, and a mini player that springs open into the full Now Playing screen — scrubber, transport, volume, lyrics and up next — as one morphing element. Every song is a generated Strudel pattern (genre sets the band, the track seeds key, chords and melody) that really plays. A SplitView sidebar on desktop and tablet; the iOS tab bar with the mini player above it on phones; light and dark.
